points.description: States at least 4 valid IPv6 objectives from the model answer, e.g. support billions of end-systems (large address space); reduce routing tables; simplified header for easier processing; increased security; real-time/QoS support (flow label, traffic class); multicasting; mobility/roaming; openness to future change via extension headers; coexistence with existing protocols. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.5 if only 2 or 3 valid objectives are given; 0 for fewer than 2.
